summary: Del Norte County, CA lookout cabin built 1935 in the Siskiyou NF; a tower stood at the summit by 1941; firelookout.org lists it as gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: lookout cabin (1935); a 1941 survey description refers to a tower at the summit
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by firelookout.org, which classes the site as a tower

events.note: Lookout cabin constructed, per a 1939 forest history quoted on the Forest Lookouts page
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description refers to the top of the tower

notes_for_editor: Coordinates conflict and are unresolved: firelookout.org gives 41.91701, -123.92618; the west_us_lookouts record gives 41.9081, -123.9391. The NGS text on the Forest Lookouts page gives only a verbal location. No NHLR or FFLOS page is cached for this site, and guessed nhlr.org URLs returned 404. The 1939 Siskiyou history is cited second-hand through the Forest Lookouts page. Peakbagging.com lists it as 'High Plateau Mtn [CA-OR]' (not used). Only two sources, so the story is short; a direct read of the 1939 history or an NHLR record would extend it.
